name: What are the first steps I should take before starting a major home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps I should take before starting a major home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before embarking on a major home renovation, the first steps involve defining your project goals, establishing a realistic budget, and identifying your preferred style. Gather inspiration, research materials, and understand your needs versus wants. This preparation phase is crucial, as it helps you articulate your vision clearly to potential contractors. Having a well-defined concept and budget will allow us to provide more accurate estimates and ensure the project aligns with your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, define goals, budget, and style, then gather inspiration and research materials before contacting a contractor.
